name: Selected everyday searches and query refinement

rubric.1: Related/background; exposure, preparation or outcome differs
rubric.2: Directly useful for at least part of the question, including relevant null findings or review synthesis

selection: Five presentation examples chosen after inspecting six original questions and four refinements. These are selected demonstrations, not a held-out or representative accuracy estimate.
scope: Relevance refers to the food/outcome question. Words such as clinical trials are retrieval preferences, not an eligibility filter. Comparator and context mismatches are recorded in reasons. Scientific validity and human applicability are not graded by precision.
